title: The Structured Frameworks Powering Toronto’s Next Generation of "Missing Middle" Builders
summary:
Toronto's housing strategy is undergoing a quiet, but important change.  

While high-rise towers still dominate the skyline, the real momentum is building at a smaller scale. The "missing middle," which includes duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and low-rise multi-unit housing, is becoming central to how the city addresses density, affordability and neighbourhood continuity.

title: Q Excavation
summary: The above-ground Harbourfront parking garage used to loom over the Gardiner Expressway here. Now it's a great big hole in the ground, at close to its final size… but in the future? This will be the home to a new condo tower of 59 storeys, soon to begin construction, as the mast of the first of two cranes at the site is being assembled at the west end of the excavation.
